description: Fork of exp003 with HYBRID attention: Q,K are linear projections (nn.Linear(qk_in_dim, H*d_qk), bias=False) — NO bit-LUT, NO dominance, NO canonicalize. Standard SDPA with default scale 1/sqrt(d_qk) on continuous Q,K and ±1 V. V, out_proj, unembedder remain as in exp003 (LUT-based). Drops 12 Q/K bit-LUTs and the q/k_canon STE; keeps V and out_proj LUTs. Tests whether the LUT-only Q/K path was the architectural bottleneck — if hybrid significantly beats exp003, gradient flow on Q/K is THE issue.
